name: Tabs
accessibility: The active tab is exposed via aria-selected, not communicated by color alone.
Focus moves logically into the panel's content (or stays manageable) when a new tab is activated, rather than getting lost.

nativeProperties.tabs-label: Audit one, Audit two, Audit three

source.notes: State, Appearance, Size and Corner radius are captured as crossed properties (State, Appearance, Size, Corner radius) - every combination draws as its own Figma variant. Each tab's own label is bound to its own Text property. Badge count is a bound Text property and Show badge a bound Boolean, with real geometry harvested by briefly showing it during export even if currently hidden. Equal-width tabs is an editable property not bound to any layer, since switching each tab between hug and fill width is a layout-mode change Figma can't perform from a bare property - the bar keeps whichever width mode was active at capture time. Tab count stays a page-level choice. Native property IDs retain canonical values; anatomy styles and tokens use context.unit.
